title: Interesting story app with a couple of drawbacks
body: As a mother of four kids under the age of 7, I always have to have a few tricks up my sleeve to keep the bedtime routine moving along with as few complaints and distractions as possible. Bedtime stories are a necessity for cuing little minds and bodies to wind down, but every night presents with different needs and requirements. I have found that not only is it important to choose appropriate story topics as they relate to the children’s ever-changing interests, questions, fears, and challenges, but the format is also key. Picture books with intricate illustrations are good for energetic nights, emergent reader books are perfect for boosting confidence and practicing independent reading, shorter stories are useful for tired nights, nonfiction books are great on nights filled with endless questions, audiobooks are a necessity on tired- or sick-mommy nights, and so on. This app provides a completely different and unique option: stories read by mommy (or the app itself) with sound effects! The sounds are appropriately spaced out and well-timed, cute, funny, and realistic. The children enjoy the stories and often fall asleep quickly and easily. One complaint I have about this app is that sometimes the sounds last for too long or are unexpectedly loud, which can either startle a child drifting off to sleep, or it can make it harder to read along with. I am also surprised to see religious/Christian content without any representation of other religions/cultures. Either include stories from a variety of religions/cultures, or don’t include any at all. While American culture tends to embrace Christianity more readily than other religions, it should not be included in a children’s story app unless explicitly marketed as such. I’m pretty sure that if the app included stories from any other religious affiliation and only one kind, it would not have been downloaded even a fraction of the number of times nor would it have garnered as many 5 star reviews as it has. Other than those two drawbacks, I’d say the app is a nice addition to have in my arsenal for battling bedtime bedlam.

title: Amazed by this app!
body: I love to read for my little one. She is in the spectrum and me reading stories for her calms her down. With Redmio she has so many options, read, hear, explore, we have languages options available, some stories have printable versions and printable activities!!! You can record yourself reading for your babies to listen your voice, wich is perfect for nights that I can’t be home on time to read her before bedtime. The illustrations are so cute and soothing. The app makes it so easy to explore and look for the right stories, for categories and ages. The only thing that I would suggest, and this is more because of personal preference for my little one, it would be nice to have some stories with illustrations between pages. Sometimes for my little one, story time is to describe a picture between pages, when she is not feeling like hearing me read hehehe. Other than that, THANK YOU REDMIO!!! And thank you to all the brilliant people who made this app a perfect and wonderful experience to enjoy and inspire little ones to read! 🫶🏻
